Overlapping roles are not counted twice

workflow_checks.evidence: Real job form and skill formset; four requirements saved.

workflow_checks.name: Save all manual professional profile sections
workflow_checks.evidence: Skills, education, certification, experience and portfolio entered through HTTP forms.

workflow_checks.evidence: Signature fixture checks storage/access; not PDF rendering or qualification verification.

workflow_checks.evidence: Signature fixture checks storage/access; not PDF rendering or qualification verification.

workflow_checks.name: Upload private certificate without extraction
workflow_checks.evidence: Signature fixture checks storage/access; not PDF rendering or qualification verification.

workflow_checks.name: Original document is private
workflow_checks.evidence: Only the candidate can access the original document library.

workflow_checks.name: Candidate requests a saved job recommendation
workflow_checks.evidence: Actual refresh endpoint, full ESCO reference and persisted explanation.

workflow_checks.name: Save an independent tailored draft
workflow_checks.evidence: Tailoring leaves the saved professional profile intact.

workflow_checks.name: Recruiter cannot read a draft
workflow_checks.evidence: Draft is absent from recruiter-accessible applications.

workflow_checks.name: Submit an application with three independent attachments
workflow_checks.evidence: Submission preserves the tailored profile and document copies.

workflow_checks.name: Owning recruiter can review; outsiders cannot
workflow_checks.evidence: Candidate ownership and recruiter job ownership enforced.

workflow_checks.name: Editing main profile preserves submitted application
workflow_checks.evidence: All professional sections retained; submitted snapshot unchanged.

workflow_checks.name: Profile text is HTML escaped
workflow_checks.evidence: Stored free text is rendered as text.

workflow_checks.name: Submitted application cannot be overwritten
workflow_checks.evidence: Subsequent editing redirects to submitted detail.

workflow_checks.name: Recruiter ranks submitted evidence
workflow_checks.evidence: Applicant ranking reads the submitted copy, not the later main profile.

workflow_checks.name: Stored score replays exactly
workflow_checks.evidence: Saved inputs, configuration, date and public reference reproduce the score.

workflow_checks.name: Recruiter matching explanation is private
workflow_checks.evidence: Saved result is scoped to its requesting owner.

workflow_checks.name: Shared attachment is readable only by application parties
workflow_checks.evidence: Original and submitted bytes match; outsiders denied.

workflow_checks.name: Recruiter status update reaches candidate progress
workflow_checks.evidence: Candidate application list reflects recruiter decision.

workflow_checks.name: CSRF-less state change is rejected
workflow_checks.evidence: CSRF enforcement enabled for all workflow clients.

workflow_checks.name: Closed job stops new applications
workflow_checks.evidence: Existing submission remains readable; another candidate cannot start an application.

limitation_probes.name: Unrelated work still counts towards declared duration
limitation_probes.interpretation: Duration includes all declared roles. Recruiters must assess relevance; duration alone is not evidence of relevant experience.
